pages.scan: Wide top panel: caption at top-left reads 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' One small ananya face box sits centre-left with no balloon, so it is a silent establishing beat. Bottom-left tall panel: meera balloon at top-left reads 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...', then a second meera balloon lower and to the right reads 'I wish everything were easier to manage!'. Both sit above the meera face box. Bottom-right panel: ananya balloon at the top reads 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' Her face box is below it.
pages.observation: The page reads naturally as top panel, then bottom-left (upper-left balloon before the lower-right one), then bottom-right. Ananya's line in the last panel clearly answers Meera's complaint, and no answer is skipped. Problem 1: the tail of the first meera balloon stops in empty space at about (226,962). That is well above and to the left of the meera face box, which starts at about (224,1048), so the tail does not reach her. Only one person is in the panel, so the speaker is still easy to infer. Problem 2: nothing on this page tells the reader who Meera is or what her role is. Only Ananya is named, in the caption. Problem 3: whether the top panel shows a 'busy day' depends entirely on the future artwork, because the board has just one small, silent Ananya box. All text is readable.
